project.note: Project requirements. In a full tool these are set per review round, with category defaults.

gates.name: Ontario electrical contractor licence
gates.rule: Licence number is held by the bidder and stated in the proposal. A subcontractor licence or a licence 'to be confirmed' fails. Not stated at all = flagged.

gates.name: WSIB clearance and $5M liability insurance
gates.rule: Both are confirmed in the proposal. One missing = flagged. Stated below $5M = ineligible.

requirement_checks.note: The deadline is a must-have, so a bid that gives no completion time cannot be confirmed compliant.

weighted.name: Relevant experience
weighted.evidence: Count of commercial installs of 100 kW or more in the last 5 years, plus the start year the bidder gives.

weighted.name: Price
weighted.evidence: Total price in CAD and whether it is all-in.

weighted.name: Timeline
weighted.evidence: Completion time in weeks from award.
weighted.rule: weight * shortest_eligible_weeks / bid_weeks; unstated or over project.max_weeks_from_award is handled by requirement_checks

weighted.name: Warranty
weighted.evidence: Panel warranty years and workmanship warranty years.

weighted.name: Team and approach
weighted.evidence: Named project lead, crew size stated, safety plan, monitoring plan.
weighted.rule: weight/4 for each of the four items present

validation: every scored criterion needs an evidence description and a rule

statuses.ranked: passes gates, scored, no blocking flags
statuses.flagged: needs a human before ranking: injection hit, missing or ambiguous gate evidence, over budget ceiling
